name: Mrs Tan
content: Painted our entire flat in 2.5 days. Edges were crisp, zero paint on our furniture, and he cleaned up thoroughly before leaving. Felt like a brand new flat.

name: Daniel Lim
content: Re-did my kitchen. Quote was 100% transparent, no surprises, finished on the exact date promised. The solid-surface countertop seaming was invisible.

name: Priya K
content: Built my feature wall and TV console. Came back twice to fine-tune the LED lighting until I was happy. That level of after-service is rare in Singapore.

name: Mr Goh
content: Full rewire of a 4-storey house. LEW-signed, EMA-compliant, zero snags at handover. Highly recommended trade specialist.

name: Aisha Bte Rahmat
content: Re-did my master bathroom. He explained the waterproofing process so I understood why it mattered. The walk-in rain shower is incredible.
